latest.title: Midterm elections: How affordability and the economy could impact voters
latest.description: Several economic issues could impact midterm elections voters. Here's what to expect on Nov. 3.

latest.title: CFTC sues Utah to block action against prediction markets
latest.description: The US state filed a lawsuit against Kalshi last week, seeking to recover up to $60 million in profits related to event contracts on prediction markets.

latest.title: Boeing shares slide on a disappointing cash flow update. Why this dip is buyable
latest.description: Boeing reset investor expectations on free cash flow growth in the coming years. We're hopeful this represents a clearing event.

latest.title: AI Agents Are Creating a New Layer of Cybersecurity Spending
latest.description: Akamai launched a locked box for AI agents on Tuesday. It joins Palo Alto, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Okta and Zscaler in selling protection for software that now acts on its own.

latest.title: Boeing stock sinks 10% as company says it won't significantly ramp up 737 Max production until late 2027
latest.description: Boeing is set to brief investors on its aircraft production outlook when it reports quarterly results before the market opens Tuesday.

latest.title: U.S. agency hits Utah with lawsuit to shield Kalshi's ability to offer betting there
latest.description: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission has pursued more than a dozen legal actions to protect what its chief sees as its sole power over prediction markets.

latest.title: Amazon's anti-tokenmaxxing memo says engineers should be pickier about using AI
latest.description: Amazon has rapidly integrated AI across the e-commerce giant's sprawling business operations under CEO Andy Jassy.

latest.title: Margin debt growth slows sharply as stock market warning signs build
latest.description: Slowing margin-debt growth could signal growing risks for stocks.

latest.title: Intel, Oracle, IBM Join Objections to OKX-ICE Tokenized Stock Venue, Bringing Total to 26
latest.description: Intel, Oracle, IBM, and IonQ became the latest companies to object to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 26.

latest.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes
latest.description: Attackers obtained the factory key that proves Keystone's hardware wallets are genuine, and 25,964 buyer records were affected. The company says recovery phrases and private keys were not involved.

latest.title: Intel, Oracle, IBM join growing list of firms objecting to OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
latest.description: The latest notice added four objections, bringing the total to 26 as the joint venture prepares to test the SEC’s new framework for blockchain-based stock trading.

latest.title: Early third-quarter earnings show a 'resilient' U.S. consumer, with signs of strain
latest.description: Companies from Royal Caribbean to Coca-Cola and UPS say they are seeing steady consumer spending despite high inflation.

latest.title: Majority of Americans want candidates who support US-based financial technology: Poll
latest.description: The September survey offered a possible window into US voters who could consider fintech and digital asset policies on Election Day.

latest.title: Speaker Mike Johnson calls election-transfer concerns ‘absurd’
latest.description: Democrats and voting rights groups have raised concerns that President Donald Trump and congressional Republicans could challenge election results if they lose.

latest.title: GLP-1 drug coverage is being dropped by employer plans: What to know about 2027 weight-loss options
latest.description: Coverage of GLP-1 drugs for weight loss is being dropped by many employer-sponsored healthcare plans as premiums soar, though workers have some new options.

latest.title: Honda warns 50% Canada auto tariffs would be catastrophic for industry
latest.description: President Donald Trump has threatened to double tariffs on Canadian vehicles and parts from 25% to 50% if a trade deal is not reached between the two countries.

latest.title: Circle Pushes Deeper Into Latin America With USDC Settlement in Colombia
latest.description: A collaboration with payments-tech firm ACI Worldwide will pilot folding USDC settlement into Colombia’s instant-payments network.

latest.title: Judge blasts prosecutors, refuses to sign new criminal complaint against ex-FBI officials
latest.description: Two ex-FBI officials were initially accused by the DOJ of lying when they testified to Congress in 2023 about their involvement in Hunter Biden investigations.

latest.title: Oracle integrates ChatGPT, Codex into apps and expands cloud chip lineup
latest.description: Oracle is integrating OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Codex into its applications and plans to add Google TPUs and OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip to OCI.
